q: How long does bridal henna last?
a: A full bridal set typically takes 2–4 hours and stains deepen over 24–48 hours. Aftercare matters: keep the paste on as long as comfortable, then seal the stain with lemon-sugar and avoid water for several hours after removal.

q: How far in advance should I book?
a: Bridal dates are held months in advance. Reach out 3–6 months ahead for weddings, and earlier for peak wedding-season weekends. Engagement and sangeet dates often have shorter lead times.

q: What does a bridal set cost?
a: Full bridal sets (both hands and feet) start around $350, with the final quote depending on coverage, detail density, and travel. Engagement and sangeet designs run lower; bridal-party sets get a reduced per-hand rate. Send the date, party size, and coverage in an inquiry for an exact quote.

q: How should I prepare before my appointment?
a: Arrive with clean, dry, product-free hands and feet — no lotion, oil, or nail polish on the skin where the paste goes. Wear something loose that doesn't cover the wrists or ankles, and plan to sit still for the session. Long hair is fine; the paste sets while you relax.

q: How do I care for the stain after the paste dries?
a: Keep the paste on for 4–6 hours or overnight for the deepest color. Once it flakes off on its own, avoid washing the area with soap and water for 6–8 hours. Lemon-sugar sealing, dry heat, and keeping the skin warm all help the stain oxidize to a deeper rust.

q: Do you offer designs for kids?
a: Yes — short, playful mini designs (tiny flowers, hearts, initials) are drawn for little hands at bridal events and sangeet nights. Kids' designs take minutes, and the same natural paste is always used.

q: Do you travel for destination weddings?
a: Yes. Travel within the continental US is available; destination weddings elsewhere are quoted case by case. Travel and lodging are added to the booking.

q: What if I need to change or cancel my date?
a: Dates can be moved once without penalty up to 14 days before the appointment, subject to availability. Cancellations within 14 days forfeit the deposit; the deposit applies to your final balance otherwise.
